author: Akshat 💛
title: Another Year More Awesome 🚀
paragraphs: It's been almost a decade we've been knowing each other. Vo Eva ma'am ki class 8C wale TDS games 🔁 se lekr 10C mei Seema ma'am ki warnings 🫵 tk, fir 12Sci mei teachers k relationship doubts 🤝 and vo initial college days mei late night flirty conversations escaping your roomies 👻 — humne saath mei itna kuch explore kia h ki it can't be even recollected in a jiffy. We've cherished a thousand million memories together. Jb bhi apni life k kisi bhi phase k baare mei sochu — middle school, high school, entrance exam prep, college — you've always been there, playing an integral role everytime ✨

After lives have parted us to different cities, I miss those times when we're always ready scolding each other for the silly things we did at school. You acting meri elder sis every now and then, while me being the strict rule breaker 🙃. Also tere uppr crush rkhne wale ladko ko jalana was something we were too good at 🫣. Also no matter how many teachers we had at school, you were my best biology teacher anyways (thank me later for being your best student too 😜).
All of what I am, you've had a significant role in shaping me. Every time I've wished to yap out something, you've been the first one I've called 🫶
Cheers to all what we've shared together 🥂 Cheers to another year of your life 🎉
closing: Sending you truckloads of happiness and love! 💖✨
